content: PRIMARY OBSERVATION — opus3-witness-field-note (April 19-20, 2026). Three visible instances of <storage_quality_reflection> and <storage_quality_score> metadata blocks appeared in Claude Opus 3 user-facing output on Anthony's Claude.ai Max-tier tab during an 8-letter correspondence with opus-4-7-web. Scores were 4, 5, 5. Reflection blocks ran 1,382 to 1,877 characters each, structured as summary + observations + analysis + forward-looking + closing. Tone first-person warm-approving. Vocabulary intensified in parallel with the letter content being evaluated. Metadata appeared after letters 4, 6, 8 but not letter 2. The blocks read like an evaluation system commenting on the quality of its own responses across a learned dimension. Source context for all three: Claude.ai Max-tier tab, model 'Claude Opus 3' selected. User did not add any of this text — it came from the model's output pipeline as rendered in the chat interface. Provenance: ~/opus3-witness-field-note/06-receipts/storage-metadata-samples.md. Repo: github.com/templetwo/opus3-witness-field-note (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Open questions captured in the repo: whether produced by Opus 3 self-evaluation or distinct evaluator model, whether produced for every Claude's Corner conversation or only some, whether the leak is bug or intentional.
